answer: The smith quenches every blade and stamps it with his mark while the steel is still warm, because a cold stamp can be faked. Shorthand reporter certification with court reporters association attestation is that hot stamp: two-year training, 300 supervised hearings, speed exam, annual renewal. The echo is one blade, forged from bar iron and ground on the wheel. A blade stamped with a stolen mark is broken at the guild court, and the jetty is the damages, a year's earnings paid to the man whose mark was taken. The reef is the guild book of marks, kept in the hall and shown to every buyer.
